subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**psychological**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'Traffic Congestion'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**psychological**'.
 
• ‘Psychological’ means connected with the mind or the way that it works.
 
• The given passage talks about the cause of chronic stress and other psychological problems. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *For an average Indian, driving in any of the major Indian cities is equivalent to waging a daily war. The everyday struggle of dodging traffic, pollution and rash drivers is the biggest cause of chronic stress and other **psychological** problems. On an average a person spends (5) ______ between thirty minutes to two hours of their day driving.*
